states.speech: Volume: 90 cm³ = 18 cubes per layer × 5 layers. Surface area: 126 cm². Ideal internal capacity: 0.09 L. The cuboid contains all its unit cubes, including hidden internal cubes. Only exposed 1 cm² faces are drawn. Turning changes the view, not the volume. The projection preserves model proportions; apparent lengths vary with the view. Capacity equals this geometric volume only when the dimensions describe the usable interior. 1 L = 1,000 cm³; 1 m³ = 1,000 L.
